## Progress

- 2026-11-03 — landed: `lib/scoped-search.ts` (`ScopedSearchScope`, `typeaheadScopeValue`, `scopedSearchParam`, `jkeyParentMap`/`jkeyChain`/`jkeySubtree`); `components/ScopedSearchForm.astro` (the ONE shared zero-JS GET form + `sig-typeahead` wrapper + typed honest variants); mounts on `dossier/[...path].astro` (At a glance, after the Explore bar) and `sources/[id]/index.astro` (after At a glance, non-registryOnly); `typeahead-model.ts` `jkey`/`chain`/`source_id` entry fields + `scopeMatches`; `sig-typeahead.ts` `scope` attribute filter; `typeahead-shards.ts` catalog emits the scope fields; DEFERRALS D-P36.56-1 (engine leaf-exact `jurisdiction`) + D-P36.56-2 (`/dossier/` wire-budget measured gap) + obligation events; `page-budgets.json` `measured_gaps` row; unit spec `scoped-search.test.ts`; e2e `scoped-search.spec.ts`; CHANGELOG entry; coverage verdicts (SIG-UI-128 + the four P36.55-owned rows the matrix checker flags after row 398 landed).
- 2026-11-03 — **two defects found and fixed in the same pass** (gate-surfaced by the new e2e): (a) `matchEntries` let a non-matching `alt` (the bare code, e.g. "US") demote a label-matched entry to −1 — every place suggestion carrying a code alt was silently dropped on every typeahead mount (pre-existing from P36.40, masked by weak assertions); the fold now only lets a matching alt help. (b) `jkeyChain` walked `getDossierIndex()` alone — page rows only — so Norman's chain truncated at the non-page Cleveland County; `jkeyParentMap` now merges the `sig.jurisdiction-key-map/1` (export), each dossier's own `chain` field, and index `parent_jkey` links.
- 2026-11-03 — verification: `npm --prefix web run check` end-to-end (typecheck 0 errors · unit <n> · build 237 pages · licences · e2e <n> passed — axe WCAG 2.2 AA, nojs-parity, link-crawl, budgets incl. the `/dossier/` `measured_gaps` bound, scoped-search spec green). `make check` see below.
